INSERT INTO scx_ocpx_rta_log(id, relay_request_id, request_id, media_id, advertiser_id, upstream_id, task_id, stage, status, reason, duration_ms, event_time) VALUES
(#{row.id}, #{row.relayRequestId}, #{row.requestId}, #{row.mediaId}, #{row.advertiserId}, #{row.upstreamId}, #{row.taskId}, #{row.stage}, #{row.status}, #{row.reason}, #{row.durationMs}, #{row.eventTime})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id

INSERT INTO scx_ocpx_rta_hour_stat(time_hour, media_id, advertiser_id, task_id, upstream_id, request_count, allow_count, deny_count, error_count, timeout_count, delivery_success_count, delivery_failed_count, version) VALUES(#{values.timeHour}, #{values.mediaId}, #{values.advertiserId}, #{values.taskId}, #{values.upstreamId}, #{values.requestCount}, #{values.allowCount}, #{values.denyCount}, #{values.errorCount}, #{values.timeoutCount}, #{values.deliverySuccessCount}, #{values.deliveryFailedCount}, #{values.version}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE request_count=IF(VALUES(version)>version, VALUES(request_count), request_count), allow_count=IF(VALUES(version)>version, VALUES(allow_count), allow_count), deny_count=IF(VALUES(version)>version, VALUES(deny_count), deny_count), error_count=IF(VALUES(version)>version, VALUES(error_count), error_count), timeout_count=IF(VALUES(version)>version, VALUES(timeout_count), timeout_count), delivery_success_count=IF(VALUES(version)>version, VALUES(delivery_success_count), delivery_success_count), delivery_failed_count=IF(VALUES(version)>version, VALUES(delivery_failed_count), delivery_failed_count), update_time=IF(VALUES(version)>version, NOW(3), update_time), version=GREATEST(version, VALUES(version))
